meta.calibrationNote: Each move done at a steady rhythm for 3 x 30 s by one body (3 seeds), counted by the game's own detector (Animal Gym / Save the Harvest: triesOf and JumpWatch) behind the real tracker. approxCm: how big the move is (jump height; torso drop of a squat; sideways lean of the shoulders over the hips; knee raise). rate = detected / attempted (march and lean count each side).
meta.sensitivityNote: Sleepy Bear, one body, 3 seeds x 13 freezes. reactionScale 1 = the child 0.25-0.6 s / adult 0.4-0.8 s of the main runs; jitter is the camera noise in picture widths (one sigma).
meta.admissionNote: The tracker's own rules, nothing assisted: 40 s standing in view. cap 2 is what ships today (PLAYING = 2); cap 4 is what the games are built for.
